answer: Sybil resistance can rest on proof-of-stake admission gating: each operator locks a stake slashed when duplicate identities are proven, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, not one. Cost scales linearly with identity count while payout per identity stays flat, so the attack turns unprofitable before it distorts a vote or reward pool. The stake sits in a vault, and auditors sample attestations as a glacier samples terrain: slowly, widely, hard to dodge. Confirmed clusters burn stake and the burned value pays reporters, so the zephyr of sybils dies out.
